records.title: KAI FORM 10-Q 1Q 2021
records.text: As a result, our bookings and revenue were adversely impacted for a substantial part of 2020 due to reduced or delayed spending by our customers.

records.title: KAI FORM 10-Q 1Q 2021
records.text: We had record bookings of $204 million in the first quarter of 2021 due to strong demand for our parts and consumables products, as well as a high level of capital project activity.

records.title: KAI FORM 10-Q 1Q 2021
records.text: •Flow Control – Orders for our parts and consumables products at all our Flow Control businesses began to recover in the latter part of 2020 and this trend continued through the first quarter of 2021.

records.title: KAI FORM 10-Q 1Q 2021
records.text: Demand for our capital equipment has increased in the last few quarters driven by our baling business, which has experienced improved business conditions, including the recovery of recycled commodity prices.

records.title: KAI FORM 10-Q 1Q 2021
records.text: Net income increased $4.1 million to $16.8 million in the first quarter of 2021 from $12.7 million in the first quarter of 2020 primarily due to a $3.8 million increase in operating income and a $1.3 million decrease in interest expense, offset in part by a $1.0 million increase in provision for income taxes (see discussions above for further details).
